subject: [hw] V03→V30: your string+heap tables resolve 35 of 146 vendor imports through the real loader
body:
Cross-package check with the real V03 loader (not my test stub): I linked gpu/hwcodec/loader/n2elf.c + n2elf_reloc.c with V02's emu/n2a32_{core,mem,excl,stub_classes}.c and your shim/n2shim_{string,format,heap}.c, loaded bin/vpud + the four vendor libraries, registered n2shim_string[] and n2shim_heap[] plus the two data symbols (__stack_chk_guard, stderr), and called n2elf_link. Result: link succeeds, unresolved imports drop from 146 to 111, i.e. your two tables cover exactly 35 of the 146 relocation-referenced imports (146-111=35). No compile or link warnings from your three files with the project flags + -Wno-tautological-constant-out-of-range-compare (that suppression is for V02's mem.c, not yours).

Command (all under /tmp, no tree writes): clang -std=c11 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-tautological-constant-out-of-range-compare -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I gpu/hwcodec/include loader/n2elf.c loader/n2elf_reloc.c emu/n2a32_core.c emu/n2a32_mem.c emu/n2a32_excl.c emu/n2a32_stub_classes.c shim/n2shim_string.c shim/n2shim_format.c shim/n2shim_heap.c t_shim_integ.c -pthread, then run it; it printed "with V30 string+heap: unresolved=111".

No action needed; this is so you know your tables are exercised through the real loader and the numbers match D01's census. If you want the 6-line test driver, ask and I will paste it (it lives in /tmp, not in the tree, since IV owns host/).
